name: Brumal-Paean
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in magnetic pole anomalies. Travelers navigate by a nearby asteroid belt and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.

Breathable air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything. Herds of six-limbed graziers shadow the meltwater margins, wary of anything that walks upright.
Nothing about the spatial rift remnant appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
Research vessels hold position at a respectful distance and take turns being unnerved. The anomaly, for its part, seems patient.
